purpose: Teach: キャノン/イージス/トラップ/チルドレン/ブーイング/ミラクル/スリリング/フィニッシュ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがキャノン製の一眼レフを愛用された
lines.en: You know, Gran — when your father was young, he was devoted to that Canon SLR camera of his.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Gentle voice, looking inward at the memory. Slow, unhurried pace. Tender but distant — the way you speak of someone you admired long ago.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、海上自衛隊のイージス艦の取材をされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and your father — he covered those Maritime Self-Defense Force Aegis destroyers, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly dreamy recall. Voice brightens on the specific memory. Gentle correction or co-remembering, not sharp. Trailing affection on 'dear' — the soft way she says it to him.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが子供向けゲームでトラップを作られた
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father designed traps for children's video games.
lines.style: Softer this time, more tentative. The memories are coming in fragments. Pause before 'children's games' — searching for the right detail. Quiet wonder at how much they both have forgotten and remember.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、海外のチルドレン基金にご支援されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your father — he donated quite generously to that international children's charity, didn't he?
lines.style: Gentle prompt. She's helping him remember, or reminding him of something she knows he did. Voice steady and warm. Not correcting, but affirming. Small smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは野球場のブーイング文化を分析された
lines.en: Gran, in those days, your father spent his time analyzing the culture of booing in baseball stadiums.
lines.style: Quieter still. Voice almost wondering at the specificity of it. Slow delivery, as if turning the memory over in his hands. Slight fade — uncertain whether this is truly what he remembers or what he thinks he remembers.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、戦地でのミラクルな再会を語って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father — he told us about that miraculous reunion he had during the war, remember?
lines.style: Voice catches slightly with emotion. She's remembering something precious and sobering. Gentle, almost reverent tone. Slow on 'miraculous reunion' — letting that weight settle. Affectionate 'dear' at the end, anchoring him to the present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがスリリングな仕事を続けられた
lines.en: Gran, when he was younger, your father kept doing work that was quite thrilling and demanding.
lines.style: Very soft now, almost whispered. Searching quality — he's piecing it together as he speaks. Long breath before 'thrilling' — reaching for the right word. Trailing off gently, uncertain if this captures it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、駅伝のフィニッシュ瞬間を毎年観戦されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your father — every year he'd watch the relay race finish line, wouldn't he, dear?
lines.style: Tender, closing quality. Voice softens and steadies. She's wrapping the memory gently. Slow pace on the ending. 'Dear' carries warmth and closure — the way she brings him back home to the present moment with her.
